navigation_reload.finding: All three failing CI traces reload while the app is still in Notes, 26-36 ms after the Today click. Reload can abort the in-flight IndexedDB transaction. The test now requires completed navigation before reload and the complete multilingual body after reopening.

page_selection.finding: Same-module navigation already has aria-current=page before its asynchronous document close finishes. The test could type the next note title into the preceding editor. The shared product test helper now also requires the old title field to close.
page_selection.reason: Give each page its own title and document-wrapper state instead of rendering a new page ID with the preceding state before effects reset it.
